# Math the golden corpus renders besides the demo vault's (#1559).
# One LaTeX expression per line, as written between dollar signs.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped.

# Matrices and arrays.
\begin{matrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{matrix}
\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{pmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix} x \\ y \end{bmatrix}
\begin{vmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{vmatrix}
\begin{Vmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{Vmatrix}
\begin{array}{cc} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{array}

# Cases, with a comparison in a condition.
f(x) = \begin{cases} x & x \ge 0 \\ -x & x < 0 \end{cases}
\begin{cases} 1 & n = 0 \\ n \cdot f(n - 1) & n > 0 \end{cases}

# Double-struck and bold letters.
\mathbb{R}^n
\mathbb{Z} \subset \mathbb{Q} \subset \mathbb{R}
\mathbb{N}
\mathbf{v} \cdot \mathbf{w}
\boldsymbol{\alpha} + \boldsymbol{\beta}

# Named functions.
\operatorname{Log} z
\operatorname{arccotan} x
\arctan x
\sin^2 \theta + \cos^2 \theta = 1
\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x}{x}

# Vector calculus.
\nabla f
\nabla \cdot \mathbf{F}
\nabla \times \mathbf{F}
\nabla^2 \phi

# Comparisons and the ampersand.
x < y
a \le b \le c
x > 0
a \& b
\alpha \ne \beta
\nless x

# Ellipses.
1, 2, \ldots, n
a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n
\vdots

# Calculus and roots.
\int_0^1 x^2 \, dx
\sum_{i=1}^{n} i^2
\prod_{k=1}^{n} k
\sqrt[3]{x}
\frac{d}{dx} e^{x}
\binom{n}{k}

# Sources pulldown-latex cannot render faithfully: spoken as their source.
{n \choose k}
\mathscr{L}
\sideset{_a^b}{_c^d}\sum
\frac{<}{
\operatorname{<mi>x</mi>}

# Primes (#1585): a prime after an element is its superscript; two fold
# into one double prime; three stay as parsed; a primed script on a
# function is grouped first.
f''(x)
f'''(x)
x_1'
\sin'(x)
\sin^2'(x)
